item.title: 🔥Toronto Founder Walk #6 — Sun Sep 20, 4:45 PM — Simcoe WaveDeck
item.description:
Address: Simcoe WaveDeck Toronto, ON Canada
💡The easy way to meet and talk with other intelligent builders and founders. Most events are designed around meeting more people. We're experimenting with the opposite. A small group. A walk. A few thoughtful prompts. Enough time to actually talk to the people you meet. After running the first few Toronto Founder Walks, one thing surprised us: Smaller groups may actually create better conversations. People who joined our last walk told us the experience felt more casual, more personal and easier to remember than being in a room with 50-100 strangers. One attendee described it as feeling…
Hosted by Sharky Liu
Source: Luma Toronto Discover

### A 90-Minute Halloween Ghost Walk Through Toronto's Haunted History
L ooking for something a little different this Halloween season?
Join us for a **guided ghost walk through the University of Toronto campus and its eerie surroundings**, exploring some of the stories, legends, and strange histories hidden in one of Toronto's oldest neighbourhoods. This isn't one of our regular walks where we're simply following a trail and enjoying the scenery.
**This is a curated storytelling experience.**
I've researched the locations, developed the route, and put together the stories specifically for this experience. We'll explore some of the darker corners of the university and surrounding neighbourhoods while uncovering the people, places, and legends that have given them their haunted reputations.

item.title: 🐟Walk: Salmon Run at Humber River & James Gardens 🍂 — Sat Oct 3, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Toronto Movies & Social Group - Celebrating 14 Years! # 🐟 Salmon Run at Humber River & James Gardens 🍂
### An Easy Fall Walk — With a Pretty Amazing Natural Show Along the Way
Every fall, something incredible happens right here in Toronto. Salmon make their way upstream through the **Humber River**, battling rapids and leaping through the water as they return to freshwater to spawn. And yes — you can actually see them doing it.
Join us for a relaxed, social walk along the Humber River during salmon run season. We'll spend about 30 minutes by the river watching for salmon before continuing along the trail toward **James Gardens**. This isn't a difficult hike. It's a chance to get outside, enjoy the fall scenery, see something you might not normally experience in the city, and spend some time with other people along the way.
